titel: The Midnight Mystery Presents: Midnight Radio Returns!

faehigkeiten.grund: Auslieferung wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt (acast liefert ueber /livestitches/ - die Datei wird beim Abruf zusammengesetzt, Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst acast.com) - Byte-Offsets veralten (bei dynamischer Auslieferung sofort, gemessen 19.08.2026) und die Zeitachse verschiebt sich mit (eine Folge war 57 s kuerzer als 3,5 h zuvor), deshalb sind auch Sprungmarken in Sekunden unsicher; Clip-Erzeugung lieferte keinen verwendbaren Ausschnitt

einzeiler: Midnight Radio returns with a new episode from Midnight Mystery.
kurzfassung: Midnight Mystery launches an official Patreon for exclusive content and support. Listeners gain access to early ad-free episodes, miniseries, and behind-the-scenes extras. The creators express gratitude to their audience before starting the new episode.
stichpunkte: Midnight Mystery launches an official Patreon page.
Supporters receive early access to ad-free episodes.
Exclusive miniseries and behind-the-scenes extras are available.
Contributions help keep the independent production running.
The creators thank their audience for continuous support.
The latest episode begins after the announcement.
beschreibung:
Midnight Radio is back. After disappearing into a black hole, Raven and the station have somehow found their way back on the airwaves. The lights are on, the signal is live, and the phone lines are open once again. New callers. New stories. Same strange hours of the night. Tune in!

If something scary has ever happened to you and you'd like to share it, we'd love to hear from you at midnightmysterypodcast@gmail.com

Raven Sinclair voiced by Daisy James.
